learning_outcomes.text: Students know and understand the technical-physical principles and systemic interrelationships of drive technology systems. Both vehicle drives and drives for mobile and stationary machines are considered.
They are able to select, describe and apply complex design and configuration methods for drive systems, taking into account system interactions.
